Purpose: Enables reviewers to understand why the AI ranked a candidate as it did
All candidates are shown, not just those above a threshold — reviewers can consider candidates the AI ranked low
System requires the reviewer to click "Confirm shortlist" — no passive acceptance
All modifications to AI recommendations are automatically logged with timestamp and user ID
Where the AI's confidence in a score is low (high model uncertainty), this is flagged to the reviewer
HR Director can view override rates by coordinator, role type, and time period
